decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted Location Plan received 24/02/2012, GR100, GR101, GR102, GR103 received 27/02/2012, P01 received 15/05/2012 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Erection of a single storey side infill extension.  Extend and raise lantern construction above existing kitchen.  Rear windows and door to be renewed to incorporate more light into the kitchen
